name: ms-evenscan
description: Aplikasi Pendaftaran Acara dengan QR Code - Muslim Scene EvenScan

scripts.build: pnpm build:backend && pnpm build:peserta && pnpm build:admin
scripts.deploy:peserta: pnpm build:peserta && pnpm --filter backend exec wrangler pages deploy ../frontend/peserta/dist --project-name=ms-evenscan-familycamp-peserta --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:admin: pnpm build:admin && pnpm --filter backend exec wrangler pages deploy ../frontend/admin/dist --project-name=ms-evenscan-familycamp-admin --commit-dirty=true
scripts.deploy:all: pnpm deploy:backend && pnpm deploy:peserta && pnpm deploy:admin
